skill.name: helm-chart-scaffolding
skill.reason: The task centers on chart structure, reusable values design, template helpers, environment overlays, and Helm-native validation, which match the selected skill's promised workflow.

data_design.determinism: Static YAML and JSON fixtures are bundled in the image. The verifier renders the submitted chart with Helm and recomputes every expectation from the visible contracts plus a hidden release overlay.

main_tests: Validate chart file layout and values schema presence.
Run helm lint for staging and prod with the submitted chart and release files.
Render staging and prod through the shipped render_release.sh entrypoint and validate resource kinds, labels, selectors, ingress host mapping, config injection, and availability settings.
Validate that prod uses HPA-driven scaling while staging keeps fixed replicas.
Render a hidden qa overlay directly with Helm to check that the chart generalizes beyond the visible environments.
Run negative lint cases to confirm values.schema.json enforces type and conditional constraints.
guardrails: Hash-check all visible input contracts and the render script.
Require the agent trace to show a successful read of the bound skill before chart edits.
Reject solutions that bypass Helm rendering with static manifests or environment-specific rendered outputs.
Check for checksum-based config rollout wiring and helper-driven label reuse to reduce shallow one-off charts.

with_without_skill_control.only_difference: environment/skills/ is present for with_skill and removed for without_skill runtime copies.
no_other_differences: skill payload is available in with_skill runtime

oracle_validation.local: Host-side rerun was not repeated after the final verifier tightening because the host lacks helm in PATH. Equivalent end-to-end validation was completed in E2B on the final task version.
oracle_validation.e2b: Current-version with_skill trials with_23, with_24, and with_25 all passed the final verifier on E2B.

contrast_experiments.observed_failure_mode_without_skill: All three effective without_skill runs failed the agent-trace guardrail because they did not successfully read the bound helm-chart-scaffolding skill file before editing chart files.
contrast_experiments.isolation: The prepared runtime copies differ only by the presence or absence of environment/skills. No task text, tests, data, Dockerfile logic, or dependencies change across the two variants.

status: template finalized with current-version E2B contrast results
